test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 8 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: 18 apple trees, 21 mango trees and 39 orange trees have to be planted in rows such that each row contains the same number of trees and all of the same variety only. The minimum number of rows in which the trees may be planted is:
solution:
Given:

Number of Mango trees = 21

Number of Apple trees = 18

Number of Orange trees = 39

**Calculations:**

Let the minimum number of rows be n.

⇒ maximum number of plant in each row = HCF (18, 21, 39) = 3

⇒ minimum row = (18/3) + (21/3) + (39/3) = 6 + 7 + 13 = 26

∴ minimum number of row is 26.
